steps.title: Review site languages and Stores
steps.detail: Edit packages/site-config/localization.ts if the site needs different languages, countries or currencies. Use the same Store key for each language of a shared Store. Apply provider setup before importing localized content.

steps.title: Connect your stack
steps.detail: Create an empty stack and register its Management Token as a local csdx alias. See packages/cms-contentstack/README.md.

steps.title: Provision the content model
steps.detail: This imports the model, applies migrations, and generates GraphQL files from your stack. Pass the storefront origin with --production-url to set the runtime environment’s locale URLs. Use cms preview if the URL becomes available later or changes. Enable Live Preview and verify Visual Editor after deployment.

steps.title: Author and import site content
steps.detail: For custom content, export cms data model/schema, write an editable content folder, validate it, then run cms data setup --plan and import. Read packages/cms-core/README.md; retain the same Migrate state on retries.

steps.title: Generate GraphQL files after manual setup or model changes
steps.detail: Run before building if you set up the stack manually or changed its model after provisioning. Pass an existing runtime ENV file with the stack and Delivery Token settings. The workspace CLI provision command already generates these files.

steps.title: Configure customer access
steps.detail: Configure Clerk credentials for apps/web and its actual origin. Keep cookies host-only. See packages/auth-clerk/README.md.

steps.title: Connect Shopify to the selected identity provider
steps.detail: Configure Clerk as the shop identity provider using packages/auth-clerk/docs/shopify-customer-accounts.md, then complete the shared Headless client setup in packages/commerce-shopify/README.md. Composition does not configure remote services. Verify session continuity against the configured Clerk application and Shopify Plus store.

steps.title: Plan storefront and identity dependencies
steps.detail: Read packages/commerce-shopify/docs/provisioning.md. Establish the actual shop, frontend HTTPS origin and selected Clerk/WorkOS environment. Create the OIDC application before connecting it in Shopify; preserve resource IDs and private credential receipts across retries.

steps.title: Configure Shopify access
steps.detail: Configure the Headless channel, Storefront credentials and on-demand Admin client credentials in packages/commerce-shopify/README.md. Enable the documented Storefront scopes, including product inventory access.

steps.title: Configure Markets for the selected Stores
steps.detail: Store, locale, country and currency mappings are explicit in the provider configuration. Review the Market plan before applying it.
commands: pnpm --filter cli cli commerce project provision --dry-run
pnpm --filter cli cli commerce project provision

steps.title: Import catalog and customer data
steps.detail: Choose the B2C or B2B JSON provisioning directory. Publish imported products to the configured Headless publication. Add Online Store publication when the selected search connector requires it.
commands: pnpm --filter cli cli commerce data setup --directory <provisioning-directory> --state-directory .migrate

steps.title: Provision catalog cache invalidation
steps.detail: Use the Admin app client secret to provision signed catalog webhooks and publish SHOPIFY_CATALOG_WEBHOOK_SECRET to the web application. Configure a reachable HTTPS origin and the documented read_products and read_inventory scopes. Shared catalog reads require the hosting remote cache handler. See packages/commerce-shopify/README.md.
commands: pnpm --filter cli cli commerce webhooks provision --origin https://<storefront> --dry-run
pnpm --filter cli cli commerce webhooks provision --origin https://<storefront> --output shopify-catalog-webhooks.env

steps.title: Prepare and publish the redirect theme
steps.detail: Use commerce redirect-theme prepare with the pinned theme source and frontend origin, then Shopify CLI to push/publish the recorded theme ID. Verify redirect paths and customer-account behavior.
commands: pnpm --filter cli cli commerce redirect-theme prepare --help

steps.title: Complete hosted checkout setup
steps.detail: This assembly uses Shopify-hosted checkout. Configure shipping and test payments in Shopify Admin, then place a test order. Custom checkout is not installed.

steps.title: Connect authenticated customer checkout
steps.detail: Requires Shopify Plus, the selected Clerk or WorkOS identity-provider connection, and a Headless Customer Account client. Register the callback and logout URLs printed by this command.
commands: pnpm --filter cli cli commerce customer-accounts --client-id <client-id> --origin <https-storefront-origin> --output shopify-customer-accounts.env

steps.title: Connect product analytics
steps.detail: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY and NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST for your project before starting the application. See packages/analytics/README.md.

steps.title: Setup notes
steps.detail: Requires Shopify Plus and a Headless Customer Account API public client. The selected Auth Provider automatically supplies its Shopify identity-provider setup recipe. See packages/commerce-shopify/README.md for common setup and the selected Auth package guide for provider configuration.

steps.title: Connect error reporting
steps.detail: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN to your Sentry project's DSN to enable reporting.

steps.title: Upload source maps
steps.detail: For readable stack traces, set SENTRY_ORG, SENTRY_PROJECT and SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN in the build environment. Keep the auth token server-only. See packages/observability/README.md.
